Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: MATI AI HUB
Message:
feat(mobile): real Supabase auth for reporter & studio apps

reporter_app:
- Real Supabase email/password login (was local-only name/phone)
- JWT stored, userId saved for field_reports.reporter_id
- Login screen: email/password form
- Offline queue: field_reports insert with Bearer token
- Schema-aligned columns (title, description, media_urls, location)
- config.dart: Supabase URL + anon key defaults
- pubspec: add http + shared_preferences
- Backward-compat 'role' getter for existing screens

studio_app:
- Real Supabase email/password login
- Role mapping: admin/editor -> director (live permission),
  staff_reporter -> editor, citizen -> reporter
- Login screen: email/password form
- StudioSession now stores userId, email, token
- config.dart: Supabase URL + anon key defaults

Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: MATI AI HUB
Message:
feat(admin_app): real Supabase auth for mobile editorial app

- Real email/password login via Supabase Auth (was hardcoded password)
- JWT stored in SharedPreferences, sent as Bearer token
- Role verification (admin/chief_editor/desk_editor only)
- AdminApi sends Authorization: Bearer <jwt> on all requests
- Login screen: email + password form instead of password-only
- Resolves mobile app 401 on /api/admin/* endpoints
